item: Catalogue-corrections report is true (no false operator edits) and a field the catalogue stops shipping never nulls a live value
summary: The Q thread's trace (fix-source-qualification/seed-kept-conflicts-2026-10-17.md) showed the upgrade boot's kept=9 was all false: a gap filled earlier in the same call with the catalogue's own value read as an edit, and another catalogue's baseline against the column default read as one, which also pushed a real edit out of the eight listed examples. sync_catalogue_corrections now moves the baseline without counting a conflict when live equals what the catalogue ships or when the catalogue ships nothing and the live value is the column default (counter advanced), and it never writes a catalogue's silence over a live value (counter dropped; R100). Reproduced on the real catalogues from a main-damaged database: boot 1 reports kept=0, the seven feeds are restored, boots 2 and 3 change no rows. Each rule has a test shown red without it.
